scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @echat/shared && npm run build --workspace @echat/db && concurrently -k "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @echat/shared && npm run build --workspaces
scripts.db:seed: npm run build --workspace @echat/shared && npm run build --workspace @echat/db && npm --workspace @echat/api run db:seed
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build --workspace @echat/shared && npm run build --workspace @echat/db && npm --workspace @echat/api run db:migrate
